question: The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was founded in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA):-**

 
 
• **It was founded in 1928. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• It was a revolutionary organization that emerged from the Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) in response to the rise in anti-colonial sentiment in India.
 
• **The HSRA was inspired by socialist and Marxist ideals, and it advocated for a revolution to overthrow British rule and establish a socialist republic.**
 
• Some of the most prominent members of the HSRA included Bhagat Singh, Chandrashekhar Azad, Sukhdev Thapar, and Rajguru.
 
• The HSRA carried out a number of daring attacks against the British government, including the Kakori train robbery and the assassination of British police officer John Saunders.
 
• The HSRA was eventually suppressed by the British government, but its legacy continues to inspire revolutionaries and activists around the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
